site_surface.short_summary: Mardu Horde is a source-authored, review-gated Tarkir wedge packet for Red-centered speed, war-bound action, earned names, total commitment, Khans-era raiding, Alesha bridge context, and strict Kolaghan and Dragonstorm boundaries.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Mardu turns the open moment into a charge before hesitation can become a rival.
site_surface.tagline: Strike while the field is open. Earn the name in motion.
best_for: readers drawn to speed, total commitment, martial code, earned names, and decisive action
players who like attack pressure, sacrifice texture, token pressure, recursion, and legendary play as support-only Commander vocabulary
reviewers checking that Mardu stays separate from generic RWB/WBR, Kolaghan continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, Commander products, color-pair overreach, seed files, and runtime readiness
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Mardu material can involve raiding, conquest, brutality, war names, strict martial hierarchy, plunder, dragon conflict, and modern survival after violence. This packet keeps exact mechanics, card facts, Commander legality, full biographies, and detailed Dragonstorm chronology deferred.

core_identity.identity_statement: Mardu Horde is Red-centered speed through war-bound action: Red supplies the impulse to act, White gives that motion code and formation, and Black turns an exposed opening into decisive advantage.
core_identity.identity_source: VM-223 evidence rows shaped by VM-224/VM-225 architecture.
core_identity.notes: This is profile wording only. The raw claims remain tied to VM-223 evidence rows.

structure.primary_structure: Khans-era Mardu is a mobile raiding horde with warrior code, earned names, khan authority, roles, magic, and low-infrastructure war economy.
structure.modern_structure: Modern Dragonstorm-era Mardu is a restored, timeline-labeled clan with khan governance, Dalkovan Assembly, generals, mobile camp-cities, civilian life, Decree of Thunder, and survival/community framing.
timeline_boundaries: Khans-era Mardu Horde is the main Horde identity floor.
Fate Reforged/Alesha material is an ancient bridge only.
Kolaghan clan is a Dragons-era boundary, not Mardu Horde continuity.
Modern Dragonstorm Mardu is restored-clan context and cannot be backfilled into Khans-era doctrine.

great_tension.summary: Mardu's speed and code can become conquest hunger when action outruns restraint.
great_tension.positive_expression: Total commitment, earned identity, and decisive action before the opening closes.
great_tension.failure_mode: Generic aggression, color-code identity, Kolaghan continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, or Commander goodstuff without a Mardu evidence cluster.

historical_timeline.summary: Warrior culture, Edicts of Ilagra, war names, Zurgo, Wingthrone, Goldengrave, The Scour, Screamreach, raiding economy, tactics, magic, and clan roles.
Ancient Mardu speed and battle identity, Alesha as young khan, war-name judgment, and Khanfall transition context.
Kolaghan clan is contrast and timeline-bound material, not Khans-era Mardu Horde continuity.
Restored clan after Kolaghan rule and Phyrexian-invasion losses, with mobile cities, modern governance, Decree of Thunder, stormsingers, clan dragons, and modern locations.

Temur-facing survival through attunement is not Mardu war-bound commitment.
